stem:
Vihaan and Rohan prepare for a class debate. Vihaan notices he feels more nervous and excited than last year and sometimes argues sharply, then apologises.

Which claims about adolescence are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Adolescence includes emotional and behavioural changes as well as physical ones.
Recognising his stronger emotions can help Vihaan choose more thoughtful actions.
Stronger emotions by themselves help him make more thoughtful choices.
Adolescence involves only physical changes, such as height, hair, and voice changes.

teacher.key_rationale: Adolescence includes emotional and behavioural changes, not only physical ones. Recognising emotions can guide thoughtful actions; stronger emotions alone do not.
